summary: Frontend mobile preview tested at 375x667 for dashboard, privacy toggle, history filters, navigation, QRIS modal, employee CRUD, and notifications.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667, the bottom sheet is clipped below the viewport; close-qris is outside viewport and cannot be tapped reliably.
Employee form sheet is clipped below the 375x667 viewport; outlet selection is outside viewport and cannot be tapped.

issues: Modal content exceeds mobile viewport without internal scrolling or keyboard-aware scroll handling.

action_items: Make QRIS and employee bottom sheets internally scrollable and constrain height to the mobile viewport.
Add stable testIDs to notification close, employee save/cancel, role options, and deletion confirmation controls.
critical_code_review_comments: All transaction, balance, notification, and employee data is hardcoded dummy state as required; no real API integration is present (MOCKED API).
Employee role includes Kasir, which is part of employee CRUD but must not become a standalone Kasir feature; no standalone Kasir/PPOB navigation was found.
Several modal controls lack testID attributes, reducing automation coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard loaded. Privacy toggle and history status filters passed. Bottom navigation to history and analytics passed. QRIS and employee modal viewport clipping blocked complete CRUD/modal close testing.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: set viewport 375x667, open qris-fab or Profil > Kelola pegawai > Tambah pegawai. The Modal sheet has fixed/minimum content and no ScrollView; lower controls render below the visible viewport, so Playwright reports element outside viewport. Mitigation: wrap sheet content in ScrollView and apply max-height/flex constraints, preserving KeyboardAvoidingView for employee form.
